title: 2.4.23 Debug Five Loops
description: Five loop programs are broken: two never stop, two are off by one, one has a do...while logic error. Fix all five and explain each bug in a comment. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Program 1: infinite loop, missing update
steps.instructions: The commented-out version of Program 1 never stops because n never changes. Write a fixed, runnable version below it that logs n from 1 to 5, then stops. Add a comment explaining what was wrong.

steps.title: Program 2: infinite loop, wrong-direction update
steps.instructions: Program 2's counter moves away from the stopping point instead of toward it. Write a fixed version that logs count from 10 down to 1. Add a comment explaining what was wrong.

steps.title: Program 3, off by one, misses the last value
steps.instructions: Program 3 is supposed to log 1 through 5 but its comparison stops one value too early. Write a fixed version. Add a comment explaining what was wrong.

steps.title: Program 4, off by one, one extra value
steps.instructions: Program 4 is supposed to log 1 through 5 but starts one value too early, printing an extra line. Write a fixed version. Add a comment explaining what was wrong.

steps.title: Program 5: do...while logic error
steps.instructions: Program 5 is supposed to guarantee the greeting prints at least once no matter what greeted starts as, but it's written as a plain while loop that can skip the body entirely. Rewrite it as a do...while loop. Add a comment explaining what was wrong.

requirements.description: The fixed version of Program 3 uses an inclusive comparison so it reaches 5

requirements.description: The fixed version of Program 4 starts its counter at 1, not 0

requirements.description: The fixed version of Program 5 is a do...while loop
